name: searchtop-10
description: Retrieval-depth sweep arm, searchTop=10. Identical to baseline except retrieval.searchTop. topK is HELD AT 8 — production DEFAULT_LIMIT — across every arm, so all arms return the same number of chunks and differ only in how deep a candidate pool each source contributes before RRF fusion. This is the complement of the topk-* sweep: that one truncated a fixed pool, this one varies the pool and fixes the cut. searchTop=20 reproduces baseline exactly and serves as the control. Query embeddings cache on {model,inputType,text} and are unaffected by searchTop, so every arm is /usr/bin/bash and the extra work is Postgres-side only. Run with --retrieval-only.
